bug,"Functional problems where the interface or feature behaves incorrectly, fails, crashes, breaks, or produces unexpected results.",bug
column21: problem,The app crashed when I opened the workout summary. The reminder settings did not work after I saved them. I got an uknown error when trying to update my profile. The streak screen showed the wrong number of days. The search feature stopped working during the session.,,TRUE

column1: confusion,"Situations where users do not understand what the interface means, what they should do next, or how to interpret the available options.",confusing
column25: misleading,"I was confused by the labels on the workout screen. I did not understand what to do after finishing the routine. The settings options were unclear and blended together. I was not sure how to change the reminder time. I could not figure out where to see my streak progress. The phone number field failed, but it never showed the required format. The heading looked like a button, but clicking it did nothing. I did not know whether the icon meant share, upload, or send. I thought I was editing the live page, but I was only changing a draft.",,TRUE

column1: performance,"Speed and responsiveness problems where the interface is slow, delayed, laggy, frozen, stuck, or otherwise unresponsive.",slow
column22: long loading,"The app was slow when loading the workout history. The streak screen took too long to appear. The routine froze halfway through the session. I waited for the reminder settings page to load. The app felt laggy when switching between screens. The refund policy was under Help, but I expected it under Orders. I was not sure whether Continue would save my changes or skip the step. The form defaulted to public visibility, but I expected private. I did not know what provisioning a workspace meant. I had to read every paragraph to find the delivery date. The dashboard showed a score but did not explain whether it was good or bad. The date 06/11 was ambiguous and I was not sure which month it meant.",,TRUE

column24: unhelpful support,"The app was hard to learn because the main actions were not obvious at first. The interface had a steep learning curve, especially during the first setup. The buttons, links, and calls to action made the app feel unintuitive.",,TRUE

column1: poor error validation,"The interface does not adequately prevent avoidable user mistakes before they happen, allowing errors through weak validation, dangerous defaults, confusing controls, or missing constraints.",avoidable error

The error messages were cryptic and ambiguous.,,TRUE

column1: poor error recovery,"After an error occurs, users have difficulty correcting it or returning to a safe state. They may lose entered data, be forced to restart, or receive no path to resolve the problem.",hard recovery
